title: Evidential-Based Higher-Order Set Argumentation Framework
abstract: arXiv:2608.27824v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Evidential argumentation extends Dung's abstract argumentation by requiring arguments and interactions to be backed by chains of evidence rooted in prima-facie elements. However, existing formalisms lack a unified treatment of evidential support, higher-order relations (attacks and supports targeting arbitrary elements), and collective interactions (sources as sets). In this paper, we introduce the Evidential-Based Higher-Order Set Argumentation Framework (EHSAF), which conservatively generalises several existing frameworks within a single expressive setting. We develop two complete semantics for EHSAFs: an \emph{adjacent complete labelling semantics} that admits multiple truth values (true, false, undecided) for arguments in support cycles, reflecting an open epistemic attitude toward future evidence; and an \emph{extension-based complete semantics} that follows a strict evidentialist stance, accepting only arguments with well-found

translated_title: 基于证据的高阶集合论证框架
translated_abstract: 证据论证通过要求论证及其交互必须由根植于初步成立要素的证据链来支撑，从而扩展了Dung的抽象论证。然而，现有的形式化方法缺乏对证据支持、高阶关系（针对任意元素的攻击与支持）以及集体交互（以集合作为来源）的统一处理。本文提出了基于证据的高阶集合论证框架（EHSAF），它在单一的表达性框架内保守地推广了多个现有框架。我们为EHSAF开发了两种完全语义：一种是邻接完全标记语义，它允许支持循环中的论证具有多种真值（真、假、未定），体现了对未来证据的开放认识论态度；另一种是基于扩展的完全语义，它遵循严格的证据主义立场，仅接受具有充分证据基础的论证……
tldr: 本文提出基于证据的高阶集合论证框架EHSAF，统一处理证据支持、高阶关系和集体交互，并为其设计了两类完全语义——允许支持循环中论证取多种真值的邻接完全标记语义，以及仅接受具有充分证据链论证的基于扩展的完全语义。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Evidential-Based Higher-Order Set Argumentation Framework (EHSAF), which unifies evidential support, higher-order relations, and collective interactions within a single setting, and develops two complete semantics: an adjacent complete labelling semantics admitting multiple truth values for arguments in support cycles, and an extension-based complete semantics accepting only arguments with well-founded evidential chains.
